title: Vector gun
subtitle: Operating modes
noGun: The party does not have the gun.

mana.name: Mana bullets
mana.effect: Attack damage uses INT instead of the weapon's own scaling.

recoil.name: Vector recoil
recoil.effect: Targets hit are knocked back and floated.

spellblaster.name: Spellblaster
spellblaster.desc: Fires the bound spell with every shot.
spellblaster.effect: The bound spell fires with every attack. Without this mode a bound spell costs 150% of its MP cost; with it, 75%. Out of MP, the shot is a normal attack.

card.name: Card
card.effect: A killing blow adds that enemy's monster card to the collection.

wide.name: Wide shots
wide.desc: Hits several body parts for less damage.
wide.effect: Lower total damage, split across several body parts per attack.

psi.name: Psi vectors
psi.effect: Attack damage uses PSI instead of the weapon's own scaling.

burst.name: Burst fire
burst.desc: Two shots per attack at 70% damage.
burst.effect: Each attack fires twice at 70% damage. Both shots consume ammo.

drain.name: Vampiric vectors
drain.effect: The user recovers HP equal to 25% of damage dealt.

siphon.name: Mana siphon
siphon.effect: The user recovers MP equal to 15% of damage dealt.

deadeye.name: Deadeye
deadeye.effect: Critical hit chance increases by 40 points.

overload.name: Overload
overload.effect: Magazine capacity doubled. All shots deal 85% damage.

hex.name: Hexed rounds
hex.effect: A hit has a 40% chance to inflict one of: blind, silence, unbalance, vulnerability, broken guard.

longshot.name: Long shot
longshot.effect: Doubles weapon range on the battle map, in any ranged form.

venom.name: Venom rounds
venom.effect: A hit has a 30% chance to inflict poison.

concussion.name: Concussive rounds
concussion.effect: A hit has a 30% chance to inflict stun.

thermalOverload.name: Thermal overload
thermalOverload.effect: A hit has a 30% chance to inflict burning.

thermalUnderload.name: Thermal underload
thermalUnderload.effect: A hit has a 30% chance to inflict freeze.

executioner.name: Executioner
executioner.desc: More damage to low HP targets.
executioner.effect: Damage rises as target HP falls, up to +60% against a target near death.

ambush.name: Ambush protocol
ambush.effect: Attacks made in the first turn of a battle deal 150% damage.

resonance.name: Resonance
resonance.effect: Damage rises with the user's current MP, up to +40% at full MP.

overpressure.name: Overpressure
overpressure.effect: Each shot deals 135% damage and consumes 2 rounds instead of 1.

hollowPoint.name: Hollow point
hollowPoint.effect: Critical hits deal 75% more damage. Does not change critical rate.

deepMagazine.name: Deep magazine
deepMagazine.effect: Magazine capacity +4 in any weapon form. Damage unchanged.

spell.noneDesc: No spell fires with the shot.
spell.hint: Only offensive single-target magic can be bound. Skills cannot be bound.

toast.unracked: Coilgun out of ammo, reverted to pistol.

locked.equip: Only Em can equip the vector gun.
locked.part: The vector gun cannot leave Em.

element.title: Element
element.hint: The element applies in every form and with any modes running.

desc.2: Fire damage, can set the target burning.
desc.3: Ice damage, can freeze the target.
desc.8: Holy damage, extra effective against undead.

form.gain: Melee form: +{bonus}% damage, {element} element. Gun form has no bonus and is the only form that can fire the bound spell.
form.gunGain: Base form: normal shots, and the only form that can fire the bound spell. SWITCH converts it into the coilgun.

gun.name: Coilgun
gun.effect: With no other form fitted, SWITCH converts the pistol into a coilgun sniper rifle: 3 shots, 4x range on the battle map. The third shot reverts it to the pistol and reloads.

abrasax.name: Athame of Abrasax
abrasax.effect: In battle the reload command becomes SWITCH, toggling between gun and dagger. In dagger form the weapon uses that weapon type's damage, animation and sound, and costs no ammo. Every switch refills the magazine. Keeps the gun's element. Only one alternate form can be fitted.

thelema.name: Blade of Thelema
thelema.effect: In battle the reload command becomes SWITCH, toggling between gun and machete. In machete form the weapon uses that weapon type's damage, animation and sound, and costs no ammo. Every switch refills the magazine. Keeps the gun's element. Only one alternate form can be fitted.

choronzon.name: Maul of Choronzon
choronzon.effect: In battle the reload command becomes SWITCH, toggling between gun and maul. In maul form the weapon uses that weapon type's damage, animation and sound, and costs no ammo. Every switch refills the magazine. Keeps the gun's element. Only one alternate form can be fitted.

babalon.name: Axe of Babalon
babalon.effect: In battle the reload command becomes SWITCH, toggling between gun and axe. In axe form the weapon uses that weapon type's damage, animation and sound, and costs no ammo. Every switch refills the magazine. Keeps the gun's element. Only one alternate form can be fitted.

nuit.name: Scourge of Nuit
nuit.effect: In battle the reload command becomes SWITCH, toggling between gun and whip. In whip form the weapon uses that weapon type's damage, animation and sound, and costs no ammo. Every switch refills the magazine. Keeps the gun's element. Only one alternate form can be fitted.

hadit.name: Staff of Hadit
hadit.effect: In battle the reload command becomes SWITCH, toggling between gun and staff. In staff form the weapon uses that weapon type's damage, animation and sound, and costs no ammo. Every switch refills the magazine. Keeps the gun's element. Only one alternate form can be fitted.

aiwass.name: Bow of Aiwass
aiwass.effect: In battle the reload command becomes SWITCH, toggling between gun and bow. In bow form the weapon uses that weapon type's damage, animation and sound, and costs no ammo. Every switch refills the magazine. Keeps the gun's element. Only one alternate form can be fitted.

zos.effect: In battle the reload command becomes SWITCH, toggling between gun and darts. In dart form the weapon uses that weapon type's damage, animation and sound, and costs no ammo. Every switch refills the magazine. Keeps the gun's element. Only one alternate form can be fitted.

baphomet.name: Talons of Baphomet
baphomet.effect: In battle the reload command becomes SWITCH, toggling between gun and claws. In claw form the weapon uses that weapon type's damage, animation and sound, and costs no ammo. Every switch refills the magazine. Keeps the gun's element. Only one alternate form can be fitted.

kia.effect: In battle the reload command becomes SWITCH, toggling between gun and gauntlet. In gauntlet form the weapon uses that weapon type's damage, animation and sound, and costs no ammo. Every switch refills the magazine. Keeps the gun's element. Only one alternate form can be fitted.

longinus.name: Lance of Longinus
longinus.effect: In battle the reload command becomes SWITCH, toggling between gun and lance. In lance form the weapon uses that weapon type's damage, animation and sound, and costs no ammo. Every switch refills the magazine. Keeps the gun's element. Only one alternate form can be fitted.

sniper.name: Coilgun
sniper.effect: 3 shots, 4x range. The last shot reverts it to the pistol.

solomon.name: Grimoire of Solomon
solomon.effect: Fitted, the book is already open when the fight starts: Em begins every battle reading, with a row of spells out of the grimoire instead of her own. It is a pact, not a gift. Graceful Death buys no turn of invulnerability with it, and the book gives back no health: it takes health for every spell read, priced on what the spell costs to cast. Only one alternate form can be fitted.

growth.footer: Frame at level {level}: +{damage}% a shot, +{atk} ATK and AGI, +{rounds} rounds
growth.label: Growth
growth.desc: The weapon's stats scale with Em's level.
